{{Description|Wherever the Shimmer gathers, a Void Storm soon follows.|[[Mr. Chase's Published Eulogy]]}}
A '''Shimmer''' is an atmospheric light that typically appears before a [[Void Storm]], serving as an early warning.

It is described to be an anomaly array of violent lights that forms in the skys. It was first discovered by Roald Scientific Expedition team in the frostlands before being consumed by the Void Storm.<ref>[[Terminal Log Recovered form a Lost Mawburrow Desert Expedition Member]]</ref>
